messages.body:
Hi my love,

I know we’ve both been busy lately, but I just wanted to pause for a second
and say how much I adore you. You’ve been on my mind all day—your smile,
your laugh, the way you always know how to calm me down without even trying.

Even when we’re apart, I feel so connected to you. It’s like you’re a part
of my every thought. I miss you more than I can put into words, but that
just makes seeing you again even sweeter.

I’m so proud of everything you’re doing. Watching you chase your dreams is
one of the most inspiring things, and I feel so lucky to be the one you
come home to (or text at 2am with your ideas 😄).

Anyway, just wanted to remind you how deeply you’re loved. Always, in all
ways.

Yours,

Cudemm 💕

messages.subject: Just Thinking About You 💌
messages.snippet: Dear Cudemm, Thank you for your beautiful and heartfelt email. Reading your words always fills my heart with warmth and reminds me how lucky I am to have you in my life. I miss you immensely as well
messages.body:
Dear Cudemm,

Thank you for your beautiful and heartfelt email. Reading your words always 
fills my heart with warmth and reminds me how lucky I am to have you in my 
life. I miss you immensely as well and can’t wait for the next time we can 
be together. Your constant support and love fuel my passion, and even in 
the busiest of days, thoughts of you help me get through. [Please let me 
know when would be a good time for us to catch up or have a quiet moment 
together, as I want to make sure we take time out to nurture this special 
connection.]

With all my love,
Mert
